intro: I build full-stack applications and cloud-native systems at Accenture, with a focus on AWS and bringing machine learning into production.
about: I’m a software engineer based in Bengaluru, working across application development, cloud infrastructure, and machine learning. Since joining Accenture in 2022, I’ve developed full-stack features, supported cloud operations, and helped integrate ML workflows into enterprise applications.

experience.description: Designing and implementing cloud-native applications on AWS, and leading the integration of machine learning workflows into enterprise production environments.
Built and deployed full-stack features, improved cloud operations, and supported application availability. Worked with cross-functional teams on data pipelines and the deployment of AI solutions.

projects.name: Vehicle speed monitoring
projects.summary: Match number plates across two checkpoints to calculate average speed and flag vehicles over the limit.
projects.details: Two logging stations capture vehicle number plates and timestamps. The system matches records between stations, calculates average speed from the distance and elapsed time, and writes vehicles exceeding the limit to a CSV file.

projects.name: Real-time mask detection
projects.summary: Detect face masks in live video with OpenCV and TensorFlow, with a conceptual extension for entry-point screening.
projects.details: The detector uses OpenCV and TensorFlow with live input from a webcam or a server. A conceptual IoT extension combines an MLX90614 temperature sensor, a Pi Camera v2, motion sensing, LEDs, and relays or automatic doors for entry-point screening.

projects.name: Movie discovery & chat
projects.summary: Browse trailers, search for films, and join a global chat in a movie discovery app with user sign-in.
projects.details: Users can sign in, browse trailers across movie categories such as popular titles, search for a movie, and participate in a global chat alongside the discovery experience.

projects.name: Spam detection with the Gmail API
projects.summary: Retrieve email content with the Gmail API and classify messages as spam.
projects.details: An email subject is used to find a message and retrieve its body through the Gmail API. The message content is then used for spam detection.

projects.name: Malicious URL detection
projects.summary: Use URL-derived keywords and multiple models to assess whether a website may be malicious.
projects.details: The project extracts keywords from a URL and uses multiple models to produce a collection of predictions about whether the website may be malicious.

projects.name: Lane & object detection
projects.summary: Detect lanes and objects in a real-time video feed using OpenCV.
projects.details: Uses OpenCV for live video processing, Hough transforms for lane detection, and a DNN detection model with the COCO dataset for object detection.

projects.name: Movie recommendation system
projects.summary: Recommend movies through collaborative filtering, starting with a movie title.
projects.details: The system takes a movie title as input and uses collaborative filtering to recommend other movies.

projects.name: Game recommendation system
projects.summary: Find related games using collaborative filtering and a game title as input.
projects.details: A game recommendation project that applies collaborative filtering to suggest games based on an input title.

projects.name: Hospital management system
projects.summary: A general-purpose hospital management website backed by PHP and MySQLi.
projects.details: A web application with HTML and CSS interfaces, using PHP and MySQLi to store and manage hospital data.

projects.name: Library management & delivery
projects.summary: Manage library books and follow book deliveries through multiple checkpoints.
projects.details: A C++ application for a university library, combining book management with delivery tracking across multiple checkpoints.

projects.name: Engineering portfolio
projects.summary: A responsive portfolio with searchable projects, accessible navigation, and motion that respects visitor preferences.
projects.details: Built with semantic HTML, custom CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. A Node.js build script generates static pages from one content file for GitHub Pages. Animations respect reduced-motion preferences, and the content remains available without JavaScript.
